dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Oh my! Why, this is delicious! Oh, the Li-Style food here in Liyue just smells so good!

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: I'm Francis, yours truly, and nothing has ever had such a grasp on my heart, or stomach, like the Liyue cuisine does...

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Did you book this whole place for yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: That's right. Yours truly trekked a long and arduous journey from Fontaine just to do business here in Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: I've only just arrived in Liyue, so seeing as I've still no friends or companions, I can only book the place for myself, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Although my original intention was to do business here, I've already decided otherwise...

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Now I only wish but to devote each day to eating Liyue delicacies, I no longer aspire to earning any money...

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Albeit I may only be able to afford eating like this for a few more days...

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: What are you eating?

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Only the best food that Liyue has to offer — Li cuisine!

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Whether it's Mora Meat, with a glimmer that's even more dazzling than the Mora spent to purchase it...

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Or the delectable Come and Get It, with its assortment of exotic Liyue delicacies all packed into a single cask...

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: And the rich aromas... Ahh, it's hard to imagine that anything, with just one whiff, could ever be so irresistible. Prepared with just the right amount of seasoning and spices, it's simply exquisite!

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: I'll let you enjoy your meal.

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Thank you. Now I should probably start thinking about losing some weight...

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Huh, where's my Matsutake and Cured Pork Dry Hotpot that I ordered?

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Oh, heavens! The sheer beauty! Nothing makes me drool like Liyue's very own Yue cuisine!

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Francis, yours truly, has already left his days of Fontaine cuisine long behind...

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Tell me about Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: My home is a country that reveres true beauty and elegance.

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Some people from other countries may find our dress sense showy and impractical, but for us, there is nothing more commonplace.

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: *sigh* Still, I've had to buy new clothes yet again recently. I swear it's the food in Liyue. It's so good, I must have put on two hundred pounds after coming here!

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: All that said, a man must eat. This is really good!

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: What are you eating?

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Only the best food that Liyue has to offer — Yue cuisine!

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: The Fullmoon Egg, for example: fish, shrimp, green peppers and eggs all blended perfectly into one dish...

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: There's also the Crystal Shrimp: its outer skin glistening and transparent like a jewel, to the point where you can see the whole shrimp within...

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: That fresh, tender mouthfeel... Ah, it's almost as if the food was still alive in my mouth. It's just wonderful!

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Bon appétit.

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: Thank you. I'll leave soon, myself... after the next plate...

dialogues.speaker: Francis
dialogues.text: ...Waiter, another plate of Golden Crab, please!
